conviction_note: No pre-release, no profit warning and no strategic item found. The only lean is my own inference from Altra's primary numbers: the Q2 run-rate plus the usual Q2-to-Q3 seasonal uplift in net operating income points to Q3 profit from property management (förvaltningsresultat) of roughly 400-415 MSEK, against Modular's 399 MSEK consensus. Against that, this name has fallen on 6 of its last 8 report days, and the stock rose 4.3% in the five sessions into the print. So p_up is 55 on a 3.5% move whose size is set by what is new in the release (the numbers are not pre-released and the guide is probably reiterated), and the signed number is +0.35. The findings sum to +0.70, twice the scaled number, because each finding carries its own conditional size; the uncertainty about the sign sits in p_up.

already_public.what: FY2026 guide: profit from property management of SEK 1,500m, set in the 2025 year-end report and repeated unchanged in Q1 and Q2. H1 delivered 700, so H2 needs 800.
Helsinki school lease (City of Helsinki, 10 years, SEK 34m annual rent), to be booked in Q3 2026 net letting
A further SEK 3.8bn of debt refinanced after the Q2 period end at lower margins. The average margin was 1.62% on 30 June against 1.96% a year earlier.
Divestment of four Stockholm-area office properties for SEK 1,187m, all conditions satisfied, closing 31 August 2026
Redemption of 15,162,096 shares, leaving 192,956,152 shares in issue
Treasury holding reached 10,775,296 shares (5.58%) on 2 September after renewed buybacks under the 2026 AGM authorisation
Modular Finance Q3 consensus from 7 analysts: income 867, net operating income (NOI) 638, profit from property management 399 (Q3 2025: 887 / 656 / 415)

new_in_release.expect: Profit from property management about 400-415 MSEK against 399 consensus: slightly above. This is an inference, not a document.

Most likely the SEK 1,500m FY2026 forecast is reiterated, since consensus Q3 of 399 plus a seasonal Q4 of about 375-400 already lands near 1,500. A small nudge either way is possible (Q3 2025 brought a raise from 1,400 to 1,430). Direction unknown.
The total Q3 buyback (only the part to 2 September is public) and its per-share effect. Mildly positive.
Property value changes and the Q3 net letting figure, which already includes the known Helsinki lease. Value changes have been negative 7 quarters running. Unknown, probably small.

findings.finding: From Altra's own Q2 numbers, Q3 2026 profit from property management works out at roughly 400-415 MSEK against the 399 MSEK Modular consensus. Q2 printed 381, including an SEK 8m early-redemption cost (about 389 underlying). In 2025, NOI rose seasonally from Q2 to Q3 (625 to 656), but consensus NOI of 638 sits only 6 above Q2's 632. Lower interest margins add a little. Against that: only one month of the SEK 1.2bn divestment falls in Q3, debt-funded buybacks add interest cost, and the SEK 3.8bn refinancing may carry another early-redemption charge.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 beat consensus on profit from property management by 4% (381 vs 365) and NOI by 4.5% (632 vs 605); the stock rose 3.1% that day. Q3 2025 printed 415 with a guide raise and fell 2.2%. The day after the Q4 2025 report the stock fell 4.7%, when the new dividend policy and targets came out. 6 of the last 8 report-day reactions were negative (my computation from the Yahoo daily series, and the Modular table in the borsvarlden article).
findings.original_quote: Under kvartalet refinansierades 3 MDSEK i räntebärande skuld ... Q3 2025 comparative: 'Driftnettot uppgick till 656 MSEK (678). Förvaltningsresultatet uppgick till 415 MSEK (388).' (Q3 2025 release, https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bb560673463d5276dc91decd80e740a3c&lang=sv&src=listed). Translation: 'During the quarter SEK 3bn of interest-bearing debt was refinanced ...'; Q3 2025 'net operating income SEK 656m (678); profit from property management SEK 415m (388).'
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus NOI of 638 is only +6 on Q2 against a seasonal +31 a year earlier, which reads as an under-modelled seasonal effect, an FX assumption, or the divestments modelled for the full quarter. If the market already expected about 410, the Modular bar would sit there rather than at 399. It cannot be distinguished from a deliberate analyst assumption, though (SEK strength, timing of the disposals), and the 4.3% run-up in the five days before the print may already price a small beat.
findings.independence: Same pattern last quarter: Q2 beat Modular by 16 MSEK (https://www.placera.se/telegram/altra-fastigheter-altra-fastigheters-forvaltningsresultat-var-hogre-an-vantat-under-andra-kvartalet-20260710). Peer NP3 reported Q3 profit from property management +12% and repeated its guide (https://www.placera.se/telegram/np3-fastigheter-np3-okade-forvaltningsresultatet-med-12-procent-och-upprepar-prognosen-20261016), which is weak and sector-level only.

findings.finding: Buybacks restarted after the July redemption. Treasury shares went from about 2.57m after the redemption to 10,775,296 (5.58%) by 2 September, so about 8.2m shares, around 4% of capital, were bought in roughly seven weeks. Profit from property management per share in the release will show the full Q3 buyback, which is public only up to 2 September.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 (7.7% bought back in the quarter): +1.1% the day after the 19:40 release. The buyback has never been the headline line on its own.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the flagging notice is public and the per-share effect can be computed. Only buying after 2 September is unseen, and consensus is quoted in MSEK, not per share, so the per-share growth headline may read a little better than the MSEK line. Hence the near-zero size.
findings.independence: The share count is confirmed by the July redemption notice (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b4825949f1b9d813eeb8c37232cac285f&lang=en&src=listed), but that is the same issuer, so not independent.

baseline_tension: Agrees mildly with the positive priced lean (+1.875) and the +4.3% five-day run-up. The small beat I infer may already be partly in the run-up, so p_up stays near 50.
language_note: The Modular Finance consensus table (399 / 638 / 867 from 7 estimates) and the history of report-day reactions were found only in Swedish Finwire/Börsvärlden copy ('Väntat förvaltningsresultat, enligt konsensus från Modular Finance med sju analytikers estimat, ligger på 399 miljoner kronor'); the English searches returned only the Q2 consensus.

The Swedish-language issuer releases carried Q3 2025 and Q4 2025 quarter detail (Q3 2025 NOI 656, profit from property management 415; Q4 2025 377), which I needed for the seasonal comparison. The English feed carries the same releases, so this is a convenience, not an information edge.
Otherwise nothing the English sources did not already carry: Altra publishes every release in both languages.
lessons_applied: 'Too small about the move' and 'let the reaction history move p_up, not abs_move_pct': abs_move_pct went from 2.8, anchored on this name's observed median report-day move of about 1.5%, to 3.5. The Q3 numbers are not pre-released, and the bar for a reiterated guide is about 2.3%.
'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the buyback finding went from +0.2 to +0.1, because the buying up to 2 September is public through the flagging notice.
'Open session_check with the verdict and a timestamp URL': written that way, with the after-close caveat from the 19:40 Q1 2026 release.
